text: {"assertions":["A websocket session bug in realtime/ws/session.ts caused dropped frames that only appeared for jobs scheduled across midnight boundaries.","The root cause of the dropped frames was floating-point rounding errors in the money path calculations.","The fix involved converting arithmetic operations to integer minor units and was submitted as PR #1186 on the fix/dropped-frames-1 branch.","The bug could be reproduced by holding a socket open through a network flap.","The fix reduced p99 latency from 6.0 seconds to 616 milliseconds.","Test coverage for this fix is located in realtime/ws/session.test.ts."]}
